ground_truth.root_cause_type: Boot/Console Timeout Failure (risBoot command failed to reach SRM prompt, resulting in an aborted boot sequence — command 1903)
ground_truth.recommended_action: Investigate node-5's console/SRM connectivity and firmware state; check serial/console link and power state of the node, re-issue the risBoot/clusterAddMember command after confirming the SRM console is responsive, and inspect hardware logs for underlying causes (e.g., stalled firmware, unresponsive console server) before re-attempting the boot. Additionally, monitor and remediate the recurring interconnect 'Linkerror event interval expired' messages on the Interconnect-*N*/T* switch modules, and address the recorded PSU failures (node-3, node-238, node-104, node-118) and NIFF network-down events (node-69, node-162) with hardware replacement/reseating as these represent secondary but recurring failure points.
